olivia_auditor: Hi team — auditor requested a single, auditable bundle proving that a recent service-account RBAC modification was reviewed, approved, logged, and that related cross-region KMS decrypts can be tied to the same principal and ticket (SOC2 CC6.1 / ISO A.9 mapping). They want: PR link + approvers, ticket (ENG-7020), cloud audit row, KMS events (region us & eu) for same principal/time, vuln-triage notes if this was remediation, chain-of-custody, and a manifest with checksum and retention proof.

ben_seceng: Acknowledged. We'll assemble: GitHub PR 4288, Jira ENG-7020, cloud audit export JSON, KMS decrypt slices (us-east1 + europe-west1), triage.md, and manifest.txt with sha256 and packaged_by.

raj_cloud: Query I ran for GCP audit logs: `protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy" AND resource.type:"service_account" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:ci-rotator@*` filtered between 2026-09-10T05:12:00Z and 2026-09-10T05:20:00Z. Exported one row. Snippet (redacted):
```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-09-10T05:12:34Z",
  "actor": "nic_devops@redwood-inference.com",
  "target": "serviceAccounts/ci-rotator@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
  "change": {
    "bindings_before": ["roles/pubsub.publisher"],
    "bindings_after": ["roles/pubsub.publisher","roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"]
  }
}
```

eve_oncall: PR 4288 link: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4288. Approved by `@ben_seceng` and `@eve_oncall`. Comment: "Approved scoped secret access for cross-region rotation job; emergency access limited and logged." Screenshots of approvals included in `pr-approval.png`.

nic_devops: KMS logs: we observed decrypts in two regions immediately after deploy. Sanitized lines below (full objects exported to S3):
```
2026-09-10T05:12:35Z  projects/redwood/locations/us-east1/keyRings/ops/cryptoKeys/rot-key  principal=ci-rotator@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com action=decrypt
2026-09-10T05:12:36Z  projects/redwood/locations/europe-west1/keyRings/ops/cryptoKeys/rot-key principal=ci-rotator@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com action=decrypt
```

olivia_auditor: Good. Couple follow-ups: (1) show the exact ticket link and whether vuln-triage was involved; (2) confirm S3/GCS object retention, lock mode, and ACLs; (3) chain-of-custody: who packaged, when, and checksum.

ben_seceng: Ticket ENG-7020 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7020) — this change was a remediation for RD-2026-88 (rotation job lacked secret access). triage.md includes root cause, steps taken, rollback plan (none used), and verification commands.

raj_cloud: Exports stored in `s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/ENG-7020/` and `gs://redwood-compliance/evidence/ENG-7020/` mirror. S3 bucket has Object Lock enabled in GOVERNANCE mode for 365 days; bucket policy restricts writes to `compliance-service` and `ops-bot` only. GCS bucket retentionPolicy is 365d and only `compliance-service@redwood` can write. I'll attach `aws s3api get-object-retention` and `gsutil retention get` sample outputs in the bundle.

nic_devops: For chain-of-custody: packaged_by=nic_devops, packaged_at=2026-09-11T10:02:10Z. Packaging script: `tools/compliance/package_evidence.sh --ticket=ENG-7020 --start=2026-09-10T05:00Z --end=2026-09-10T06:00Z`. Output zip: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/ENG-7020/pkg-20260911-1002.zip sha256=2a7f9b3c4d... (manifest.txt includes the full hex).

evidencebot: EvidenceBuilder: packaging started by nic_devops at 2026-09-11T10:02:10Z job_id=evid-20260911-1002. Upload complete.

olivia_auditor: Also need to prove the principal identity matches between IAM change and KMS decrypts but without exposing live emails. Use deterministic principal hashing the auditor can reproduce.

ben_seceng: We'll include `principal_hashes.csv` with entries like `ci-rotator,sha256(ci-rotator@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com)=d4c3b2...`. Certificate in manifest: `unhashed_principal_location=compliance-vault://ENG-7020/principal_mapping` and note that unhashed mapping is available to auditors under NDA.

nic_devops: I've added `timeline.png` (visual sequence), `readme.txt` mapping artifacts to ISO A.9 and SOC2 CC6.1 text, `triage.md` with mitigation and verification, `pr-approval.png`, `iam-audit.json` (redacted), `kms-decrypts.log` (sanitized), `manifest.txt`, and `manifest.sha256`.

olivia_auditor: One last ask: was any emergency access or break-glass used in the window? If so, include the emergency justification and approvals.

ben_seceng: No emergency break-glass was used. There was an expedited but normal review via the oncall rotation and approvals recorded in GitHub and the Jira approval comments. We'll include the approval comments screenshot.

nic_devops: Bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/ENG-7020/pkg-20260911-1002.zip size=4.0MB checksum=2a7f9b3c4d... retention=365d. Manifest entry: `packaged_by=nic_devops`, `packaged_at=2026-09-11T10:02:10Z`, `object_lock=GOVERNANCE`, `retention_days=365`.

evidencebot: EvidenceBuilder: upload verified, job_id=evid-20260911-1002, status=success.

olivia_auditor: Received bundle. I'll validate offline and follow up if they need the unhashed principal mapping under NDA. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
